definition.en: The clear curved front surface of the eye, which admits and bends light.
definition.zh: 眼前透明、弯曲的表面，让光进入并折光。

definition.en: The opening in the iris through which light enters the eye.
definition.zh: 虹膜中央让光进入眼内的开口。

definition.en: The coloured ring that controls the size of the pupil opening.
definition.zh: 调节瞳孔开口大小的有色环形结构。

definition.en: A clear inner structure that works with the cornea to focus light and changes shape during accommodation.
definition.zh: 与角膜共同聚焦光线的眼内透明结构，调节时会改变形状。

definition.en: The light-sensitive tissue lining the back of the eye; its cells begin conversion from light to electrical signalling.
definition.zh: 眼内后部能感光的薄层组织，其中细胞开始把光转成电信号。

definition.en: The nerve carrying signals from the retina towards the brain.
definition.zh: 把视网膜信号传向大脑的神经。

definition.en: A refractive condition in which distant light focuses in front of the retina and distant objects can look blurred.
definition.zh: 远处光聚在视网膜前、远物可能模糊的屈光状况。

definition.en: The thin membrane at the end of the ear canal that vibrates in response to incoming sound.
definition.zh: 外耳道尽头随传来声音振动的薄膜。

definition.en: The three connected middle-ear bones: malleus, incus and stapes.
definition.zh: 中耳里相连的锤骨、砧骨与镫骨的合称。

definition.en: The ossicle whose handle contacts the eardrum and whose head meets the incus.
definition.zh: 柄部接鼓膜、头部与砧骨相接的听小骨。

definition.en: The middle member of the ossicle chain, linking malleus and stapes.
definition.zh: 听骨链中间连接锤骨与镫骨的骨。

definition.en: The stirrup-shaped ossicle whose footplate moves at the oval window.
definition.zh: 形似马镫、底板在卵圆窗处活动的听小骨。

definition.en: The curled, fluid-filled hearing structure of the inner ear, containing sensory structures that convert movement into signals.
definition.zh: 内耳里卷曲、充满液体的听觉结构，感受结构把运动连接到信号传递。

definition.en: A sensory cell with a microscopic hair-like bundle whose bending helps initiate electrical signalling; not an ordinary hair.
definition.zh: 带微小毛发状束的感受细胞，小束弯曲帮助启动电信号传递，不是普通毛发。

definition.en: The nerve carrying hearing signals from the inner ear towards the brain.
definition.zh: 把内耳听觉信号传向大脑的神经。

definition.en: The number of repeating cycles per unit time; hertz expresses cycles per second.
definition.zh: 单位时间内重复振动的次数；赫兹表示每秒次数。

definition.en: The maximum displacement from a rest position in an oscillation. Here it is a chosen relative particle displacement, not a decibel reading.
definition.zh: 往复运动中离开静止位置的最大偏移；这里是选定的相对粒子位移，不是分贝读数。

definition.en: The perceived highness or lowness of a sound, related to frequency.
definition.zh: 声音听起来高或低的感觉，与频率有关。
